change_summary: The paper has been withdrawn at the editor's request because the indoor temperature records had been processed with an incorrect sensor calibration. The notice says the reported results cannot be relied on, and the full text was replaced by the withdrawal statement. The stored version's headline result, a 2.1 °C lower mean daily peak indoor temperature in green-roofed flats, rests on those data.
evaluation: Your draft sets the model's green-roof indoor cooling effect to 2.1 °C in Section 2.2 and describes it as measured by Okafor et al. [14]. Your Discussion says the green-roof result scales almost directly with the 2.1 °C taken from Okafor et al. [14], which matches the stored paper's headline result of 2.1 °C lower peak indoor temperature. The withdrawal notice says the indoor temperature records had been processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, and that the reported results cannot be relied on. The change therefore touches both the Methods parameter and the Discussion's reliance on it. The impact on your draft is high, since your main estimate depends on this one value.
recommendation: The paper was withdrawn because the indoor temperature records had been processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, and the notice says its reported results cannot be relied on. Your Section 2.2 sets the model's green-roof indoor cooling effect to 2.1 °C, and your Discussion says the green-roof result scales almost directly with the 2.1 °C taken from Okafor et al. [14]. Raise this with your co-authors or supervisor before editing, since the model parameter needs replacing and the model re-running. Then drop or replace the citation as evidence, re-check the Discussion's estimate, and cite the withdrawal notice if you mention the paper.
